summary.intent: Execute all plans in GSD phase 68.1 (web-client-runtime-integration) using wave-based parallel subagent execution, with the orchestrator staying context-lean while each subagent handles a full plan.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 (plan 68.1-01, owned write-body foundation) completed successfully after a mid-stream stall and background resume — 3/3 tasks, 5 commits, SUMMARY/STATE/ROADMAP updated, verification gates (build, sdk-core tests, drift checks) passed. Wave 2 (plans 02, 03, 05, 07) was then spawned in parallel; plan 08 was deferred to run after 02 due to a file overlap on packages/sdk/src/client.ts.

repo: In cipher-box's GSD plan structure, plans 02 and 08 both touch packages/sdk/src/client.ts, forcing sequential execution (order: 02, 03, 05, 07, 08) despite being in the same nominal wave.

Plan 68.1-01 required touching packages/sdk/src/bin/index.ts (deleteToBin/restoreFromBin publish calls) even though the plan's file list implied only client.ts — bin.ts is where those publish calls actually live.

CipherBoxClientConfig.rootWriteKey was made optional (mirroring rootIpnsKeypair) rather than required as the plan implied, since self-bootstrap needs both and host wiring lands in a later plan (68.1-03).

Legacy test fixtures (helpers.ts, bin.test.ts) needed updating for a new required FolderState.writeKey field; fixtures use a zero-key legacy path to preserve no-network publish behavior in unit tests.
workflow: GSD execute-phase workflow's completion-signal fallback: when a subagent stream stalls mid-execution, spot-check filesystem/git state before deciding whether to resume — then resume the same agent in the background with SendMessage rather than restarting it.
Resuming a stalled subagent via SendMessage preserves its full context, letting it finish uncommitted work, write SUMMARY.md, and update tracking state itself.

Post-wave gating sequence: spot-check SUMMARY, run wave:post drift-gate hooks, run post-merge build gate, run post-merge test gate scoped to the affected package, then run pre-next-wave dependency/key-links checks before spawning the next wave's agents.

friction: Wave 1 executor agent stalled mid-stream after 119 tool calls (~23 minutes), requiring orchestrator intervention (spot-check + background resume) instead of completing cleanly.
Plan 68.1-01's stated file list was inaccurate/incomplete (missed bin/index.ts), requiring an in-flight deviation during execution.
open_items: Wave 2 execution (plans 02, 03, 05, 07) was in progress at transcript end; plan 08 still queued to run after plan 02 completes due to client.ts overlap.

Remaining waves 3-5 (preview UI, share/invite creation, version surface, kind-cache wiring, e2e suite plan, and final gates: code_review, close_parent_artifacts, regression gate, gsd-verifier, phase.complete, PROJECT.md update) not yet executed.
Host wiring for rootWriteKey/rootIpnsKeypair self-bootstrap explicitly deferred to plan 68.1-03.
